transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I came in because... I guess nothing really feels like mine anymore. I used to actually get excited about things, you know? Looking at murals around town, going for runs, watching basketball... even just making a really good drink at work. But lately, I just stand there. It's like I just don't care about any of it.
Have you noticed that you no longer enjoy activities that you used to find pleasurable, like looking at murals, running, or watching basketball?

Yeah, exactly. Like I was just saying, that's exactly what it is. I just don't get any enjoyment out of them anymore. Those were the things that used to get me going, but now... yeah. I just don't care about any of it at all.
Do you feel down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I guess so. I mean... I wouldn't say I feel sad all the time, exactly. It's more just... flat, you know? Like there's just this weight on me, most days. I wake up and I just feel kind of empty, and it pretty much stays that way until I go to sleep. So, yeah, I'd say most of the day, pretty much every day.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, my appetite is pretty much gone. Most days I just... I forget to eat entirely. I usually don't even realize it until my hands start shaking while I'm working behind the bar. Then, you know, after closing, I might try to grab a few bites of something cold, but honestly, I just feel sick even looking at food right now. So yeah, I'm definitely not eating much.
Have you been having trouble sleeping, or on the contrary, do you find yourself sleeping much more than usual?

Yeah, definitely trouble sleeping. I'll lie down and I'm exhausted, but my head just keeps going. I just lay there going over every little mistake I made at work. And then... well, when I finally do manage to fall asleep, I end up waking up around four or five in the morning. Once my eyes open, that's it. I just can't get back down.
Have you noticed that you're moving more slowly than usual, or conversely, that you can't sit still and feel restless most days?

I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, I'm tired all the time from not sleeping, so maybe I'm a little sluggish just from being worn out, but... I don't think I'm moving in slow motion or anything. And I'm not really pacing or feeling restless, either. Just tired.
Have you noticed a big drop in your energy levels or feel unusually fatigued, even when you haven’t done anything physically demanding?

Yeah, definitely. It's like I have no energy at all. Just doing basic stuff at work... by the time I carry a couple cases of liquor from the back or just set up the well for the shift, my body feels like I've already worked a double. And that's even if I barely did anything before getting to work. It's just this heavy, draining feeling all the time.
Have you found yourself feeling guilty or worthless about things you've done — or even things you haven't done — lately?

Yeah, I do. I just... I keep thinking about how I let down the younger bartenders I work with. And there were these local artists I promised some wall space to at the bar, and I just completely dropped the ball. I feel like I wrecked their shot. Honestly, it makes me feel pretty worthless, like... like I deserve whatever bad things happen to me for messing that up for them.
How long have you been feeling this way?
It's been going on for about two months now. That's when the bar got bought out by new owners. Everything I had been working toward there just... got changed overnight. So yeah, about two months.
Have you had episodes like this before, where you felt this way for several weeks or more?

No, I haven't. I mean... I've had bad days before, or maybe a rough week here and there when things got stressful at work. But nothing like this. Never this heavy, and definitely never for this long. This is the first time it's ever been like this.
Have you ever felt like life isn’t worth living, or had thoughts about ending your life?
No, I haven't. I mean... things feel really heavy and bleak right now, but I haven't had any thoughts about ending my life. I don't want to die or anything like that. I just... I just feel awful.
Have you ever experienced a period of time before this one where you felt down or lost interest in things for more than two weeks?

No, like I mentioned a minute ago, I really haven't. I've never gone through a stretch where I felt down or just didn't care about things for weeks on end before this. This whole experience is completely new to me.
Have you ever had a period of time where you felt unusually high, extremely energetic, or so confident that you didn't sleep much but still felt rested?

No, I haven't. I've never had anything like that happen. I'm just a regular guy, you know? I work my shifts, get tired, and need my sleep. I've never had a time where I felt super energetic or didn't need to sleep.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this one where you felt down, lost interest in things, or had similar struggles that lasted for several weeks or more?

I... I think I just answered that one. No, I haven't. Like I said, this is the first time anything like this has ever happened to me. Before this started, I was just living my normal life. I've never had a time where I felt this down for weeks on end before.
